artifact.title: Geofence and Working Hours Validation for Employee Time Punch
artifact.description: Implement a Python microservice function validate_punch(employee_id, timestamp, lat, lng) that verifies whether an employee time-punch event is physically located within 100 meters of the designated office at coordinates (12.9716, 77.5946) and occurs between 06:00 and 22:00 local office time (Asia/Kolkata). The function must validate inputs and outputs using strictly typed Pydantic models and return a model containing 'valid' (boolean) and 'reason' (string or null).
acceptance_criteria: The function returns valid=True with reason=None (or empty string/success message) when a punch is within 100 meters of (12.9716, 77.5946) and timestamp evaluates to local office time between 06:00 and 22:00 inclusive.
The function returns valid=False with an appropriate descriptive reason if the punch location exceeds 100 meters from the office coordinates.
The function returns valid=False with an appropriate descriptive reason if the punch occurs outside the local hours of 06:00 to 22:00.
Input parameters and output results are modeled using strictly typed Pydantic v2 schemas.
Geodesic or Haversine distance calculations are used to accurately compute the distance in meters relative to (12.9716, 77.5946).

entities.name: PunchEvent
entities.description: Represents an employee time-punch attempt with spatial and temporal attributes.

entities.name: ValidationResult
entities.description: Validation response indicating whether the punch is accepted and why.

entities.name: OfficeLocation
entities.description: Reference office location and operating hours configuration.

relationships.description: PunchEvent location and timestamp are verified against OfficeLocation geofence and operating hours.
Validation process evaluates PunchEvent to produce a ValidationResult.

constraints: Office coordinate is fixed at lat 12.9716, lng 77.5946.
Office local time zone is Asia/Kolkata (UTC+5:30).
Allowed time range is 06:00 to 22:00 local time.
Strict type checking and Pydantic validation must be enforced on all input and output objects.
non_functional_requirements: Validation execution must complete with sub-millisecond computation latency per request.
Distance calculation algorithm must handle Earth curvature accurately (e.g., Haversine formula).
